name: What should I prepare before discussing material selections for my renovation with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before discussing material selections for my renovation with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our in-depth material selection discussions, it's helpful for homeowners to gather inspiration images, such as from Houzz or Pinterest, that reflect their preferred styles and aesthetics. Considering your lifestyle needs, such as durability for high-traffic areas or specific maintenance preferences, can also guide our recommendations. This preparation allows us to better understand your vision and priorities, enabling AKN Design Group to curate and present material options that align perfectly with your unique preferences and the overall design objectives of your customized renovation project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before discussing material selections, prepare inspiration images and consider your lifestyle needs and preferences to help guide our recommendations.
